method: Optional application and source snapshot reviewed together: the ARM binary is rebuilt from sdk/optional-src/human-detect, the model is project data, and each statically linked Apache-2.0 component ships its notice text

details.distribution: sdk/optional/human-detect ships the 237364-byte ARM binary and its complete notice set. sdk/optional-src/human-detect contains the reviewed source snapshot, project-owned model data and pinned third-party source trees; generated objects and the built executable are excluded from the source snapshot.
details.license: Project code, dashboard assets and model data are BSD-3-Clause, copyright 2026 Nsing Technologies Inc. TensorFlow Lite Micro and CMSIS-NN are Apache-2.0; FlatBuffers and gemmlowp headers are Apache-2.0. The exact license texts ship in sdk/optional/human-detect/licenses/ and in the source tree.
details.linked_code: The executable is linked as a C program with -nostdlib++ so it does not require libstdc++ at runtime. It dynamically needs only libc.so.0, supplied by the SDK uClibc runtime; TensorFlow Lite Micro, CMSIS-NN, FlatBuffers and gemmlowp code are linked into the executable.
details.build: Reproduced with make human-detect using the repository ARM uClibc/FDPIC toolchain, then published byte-for-byte with make publish-human-detect. The source snapshot digest covers 513 distributable files and excludes generated build outputs.
details.model: The person position model and its lookup tables under sdk/optional-src/human-detect/model/ were trained for this project. They are not copied from a TensorFlow sample or third-party model release.
details.elf: ARM 32-bit PIE (ET_DYN, interpreter /lib/ld-uClibc.so.0, NEEDED libc.so.0). The read-only PT_LOAD is 181692 file/memory bytes; the writable PT_LOAD is 1484 file bytes and 488528 memory bytes including BSS. GNU_STACK is explicitly non-executable with a 32768-byte stack reservation.
